metaDescription: Generate robots.txt Disallow rules for filter, sort and tracking parameters, or block all parameters except a few. Free, in your browser.
intro: Builds the wildcard rules that keep crawlers out of faceted URLs, and tests sample URLs against them.
why:
Filters such as ?color=red&size=m create endless URL combinations. Blocking the parameters in robots.txt saves crawl effort, but the patterns must cover both ?param= and &param=, and a careless pattern blocks pagination.

List the parameters to block, or block everything and keep a few, and get the rules plus a test on sample URLs. Remember robots.txt stops crawling, not indexing; canonical tags are the safer consolidation tool.
howTo: List parameters to block, one per line.
Choose block listed or block all except the kept ones.
Test your real URLs with the robots.txt tester.

faq.a: A parameter can follow ? or &, so both are covered.

faq.q: Will blocked URLs leave the index?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Linked blocked URLs can stay indexed without content.
Often yes, because crawlers can read it. Blocked pages cannot show it.
Keep it crawlable using the kept parameters option.
